Class Triangle

java.lang.Object
com.cooke.shapes.Shape
com.cooke.shapes.TwoDimensionalShape
com.cooke.shapes.Triangle
public class Triangle extends TwoDimensionalShape
Triangle Class and TriangleType enum class Creates a Triangle object with three sides of adjustable lentgth; The triangle area and triangle type is calculate when a new triangle is created and when any side is adjusted. filename: Triangle.java creation date: 20261027
